sources.common_harness: Identical complete 30-cell definitions in both arms. The nine direct encoding cells disable only the mock completion watch outside the measured interval; admission and shared delivery retain it.

method.quiet_gate: Before each leg: two accepted samples at least 30 seconds apart, load1 below 2, all governors performance, no competitors, no swap delta.
method.failure_rule: FAIL only when ABBA and confirmation both exceed the threshold.
method.independent_build: Both timed arms were freshly rebuilt for the common harness correction; matching library feature/profile graphs and corresponding executable hashes were verified against independent builds.
method.adaptive_charging: The 4 ms target and initial charging boundary are unchanged. Both begin charging after source-slice materialization; the candidate also charges partial-group resumption.
method.cell_identity: cell is Criterion directory_name, which can flatten function-name slashes; canonical_id is the benchmark.json full_id. Both are retained for traceability.
method.design: Per-frame negotiated-maximum headroom; exact length for already encoded shared frames. No route-size estimator or RIB change.

outbound.scope: sum of synchronous session admission elapsed intervals from Instant; real cursor; controlled in-memory writer; excludes drain time; not thread CPU or TCP throughput
outbound.statistic: Criterion median point estimates; symmetric A/A max/min; mean of counterbalanced ABBA pair ratios

independent_replication.reason: Not run: the full campaign has six confirmed failures; none of those six is A/A-noisy. The single-campaign stop rule applies.

independent_audit.reason: All 30 canonical cells, every raw median, all eight command exits and quiet gates, and post-run executable hashes independently verified.

final_timing_reason: Historical timing rule FAIL: 24 PASS and six confirmed regressions. The measured cost is accepted for this correctness fix; no further timing campaign is required.

memory.input_fixture: Held throughout and excluded from requested-allocation deltas.
bars: candidate first, held, plateau and peak held writer bytes <= 655358
no requested-allocation growth during 1024 blocked advances
drained and dropped requested allocations <= pre-admission baseline
ordinary complete drains match control frame count and wire bytes
FlowSpec complete ordered frame streams match control byte for byte
each fixed FlowSpec shape peak requested delta <= parent delta + 1048576
AttrSet size 56, alignment 8 and Arc requested size 72 unchanged
memory.fixture: Established-session fixture with negotiated capability state: OPEN/KEEPALIVE are injected through drive_fsm, the writer task is aborted, and its 4096-slot channel is replaced with a controlled channel writer. Unsent FlowSpec work is counted from queued output and checked by complete decoded ordered drain.
memory.flowspec_peak_bar_scope: Prospective fixed-shape transient scratch bar, separate from the writer byte cap; does not assert a general memory bound.
memory.preparation_lifetime: Transient per active peer slice: local prepared attribute forms and grouping storage are released before writer backpressure parks the session. Extended peak 271210398 requested bytes; additional paused plateau 818898 bytes including 654630 queued bytes. Concurrent active preparation may compound peaks. The unchanged source fixture is excluded.

scope: Outbound timing sums synchronous session admission elapsed intervals; writer draining is excluded.
The final source restores the RIB attribute code to the parent; no inbound timing scope applies.
Neither timing metric is thread CPU time or TCP throughput.
Allocation numbers are requested bytes, not RSS or whole-daemon capacity.
No private or non-unicast TCP throughput, fleet scale, sustained memory soak, forwarding or release-wide qualification is established.

tcp_comparison.reason: Parent Linux peak-memory accounting integrity failure stopped comparison before any candidate repetition. Separately tracked measurement-tool defect; excluded from correctness gate.
